parameters: And if you are going to practice spells,
Two Honey Bread, three Sweet Buns...
and not a single bite missing?
So... Class 3. You have that look on your face,
the one your father gets before he leaves.
Then promise me you'll say goodbye properly
You're going back to the market, right? Right?
I just came back from the market.
The Tailor has a silk ribbon. Midnight blue.
Ask me tomorrow, Selene. Today I have plans.
Oh? The great Class 3 mage is off to see the world...
and he can't even handle one little errand?
If you can't manage a small mission like this,
how are you going to manage the big ones?
Yay! Here, I saved up for it.
Midnight blue! Not navy, not sky blue. Midnight!
Buy the \C[6]Silk Ribbon\C[0] at the \C[6]Tailor's stall\C[0] in the Market District,
then bring it home to Selene.
Did you get everything on my list?
Two Honey Bread and three Sweet Buns.
The Baker's Stall in the market has them.
And if you are going to practice spells,
And if you are going to practice spells,
A family portrait. Six Ashveils, all with the
same stubborn look in their eyes.
Fire mages never have to wait for hot water.
Midnight blue, Brother! From the Tailor in the market.
Not navy. Not sky blue. Midnight.
Do you have any idea what time it is?
Selene waited for you all evening.
She went to bed an hour ago.
(The ribbon... It'll have to wait until morning.)
Good evening. My name is Ryuzetsu Yuki.
I've come from Hōrai. Forgive me for calling so late.
She's only just arrived in the capital, Mom.
She's got nowhere to stay tonight.
Then she stays here, of course.
From Hōrai... You have come a long way, Yuki.
Have the two of you eaten?
I thought not. Sit down, both of you.
Two bowls of beef stew, still steaming,
and the last of the Golden Crust bread.
Stew... We have stew in Hōrai as well.
Oh? Is it like this one?
...Not at all. Ours is lighter, with miso and fish.
This one is rich. Heavy, in a good way.
Wait till you try her apple pie.
There is no apple pie, Kaelen.
Not for boys who come home at midnight.
The guest room on the second floor is ready for you, Yuki.
Goodnight, you two. Don't stay up too late.
So, Yuki. You came a long way.
What are you looking for out here?
Half a year ago he left Hōrai in the night.
They say he took a ship west.
Your brother? Then he'll be glad to see you,
When I find him, I will settle what he did.
That is all I'll say about it tonight.
I'm going to see the world anyway.
If your brother's out there, our road will cross his
You'd travel with a woman who drew her sword
You'd travel with the guy who beat you?
Beat me? The guards stopped that fight.
Goodnight, Kael. Thank you for the stew.
Kael finds a pen and a sheet of paper.
I found more of them. A whole crate of black crystals
in Briarwood, the same as the shard from the wolf.
A crew of bandits was carrying them through the Main Gate
for hooded clients who never give a name.
I kept one. Tomorrow I leave the capital,
to see the world, like you told me to.
(I'll send it with the morning post.
Wherever she is, it'll find her.)
Come and sit down. Breakfast is getting cold.
The market, the prison, the bandits!
She says the guards had to stop your fight
So. You really are going today.
Yeah. I promised I'd say goodbye properly.
Don't look so solemn about it.
It's not as if you're leaving forever.
You'll be back the moment you run out of clean clothes.
Bring Selene a souvenir from every town you visit.
Yuki, dear. Look after him for me.
Set out into the world with Yuki.
